title: Pronouns
subject: Language Arts
description: Little words like he, she, it, and they that take a noun's place!

video.title: Pronouns for Kids | Grammar for Elementary Students

steps: A pronoun is a word that takes the place of a noun (a naming word).
Instead of saying 'Morgan reads. Morgan smiles.' we say 'Morgan reads. SHE smiles.'
Pronouns for people: I, you, he, she, we, they. For things: it.
Use 'he' for a boy, 'she' for a girl, 'it' for a thing, and 'they' for more than one.

questions.correct: Takes the place of a noun
questions.hint: It stands in for a naming word.
options: Takes the place of a noun

questions.prompt: Which pronoun fits? 'Dad is tall. ___ plays cricket.'
questions.hint: Dad is a man, so we use...

questions.prompt: Which pronoun takes the place of 'the mango'?
questions.hint: A mango is a thing, not a person.
Pronouns stand in for people or things.
